title: Persepolis (bc30)
synopsis: Based on Marjane Satrapi's autobiographical graphic novels, Persepolis follows a rebellious and outspoken young Iranian girl, Satrapi, growing up in Tehran during and after the 1979 Islamic Revolution. Like other girls her age, Satrapi is full of imagination and longs to freely explore the world. However, with the arrival of the revolution, everything has changed. Through her eyes, we witness the fall of the Shah, the rise of the fundamentalist regime, the devastating Iran–Iraq War, and the tightening restrictions on women's freedoms. In light of the mass protests that erupted in 2025, the war with Israel and the passing of Satrapi this June, rewatching the film feels all the more poignant.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 導演在革命爆發時，仍是個八歲小女孩。和其他同齡女孩一樣，她熱愛幻想，具備冒險精神，嚮往自由自在的生活。德黑蘭的生活，本應是無憂的；革命到來，世界不再一樣了。年紀輕輕的女孩提早接觸到成年世界的殘酷，經歷着現實社會的巨大變動。畫面是簡單的黑與白，但故事中的愛恨悲喜卻絕未因此而有半點褪色。近年伊朗再度爆發大規模示威，以至後來的以伊戰爭，人民的自由與女性權益再度受壓。今年六月導演莎塔碧離世，此時此刻重看，別具意義。
